upstream: fixed exact HTTPS api_origin; no request-selected upstream

secret.source: same generated FREE_TICK_SECRET as protected backend config
secret.custody: Worker server-side secret only; no VITE variable, frontend bundle, URL/query/body or logs

scheduled.redirects: deny; do not forward secret to a redirect target
scheduled.work: network request only; all computation/checkpoints run inside bounded backend tick

browser_fetch.api_proxy: same-origin /api; preserve exact Host/origin/CSRF contract and stream bodies
browser_fetch.direct_storage: presigned uploads/downloads avoid Worker/web body limits

publication_gate: Use actual deployed Worker + backend receipt; validate free CPU/subrequest/request allowances and cold starts; no SLA/anti-sleep promise.
